name: InVariant
description: Infrastructure intelligence platform. Live-traffic stack fingerprinting, a call graph engine (9 node types, 10 edge types, 8 analyses), a Rust CLI, and the open-source clipy. 30 founder conversations, validated with 12 founders.

name: CatalystIQ
description: B2B SaaS built directly with companies, Dec 2023 – Apr 2024, serving 250+ businesses across all products.

phases.name: Phase 1 — Services
phases.description: Services-based business building web apps and product designs for clients. First revenue, first client relationships.

phases.name: Phase 2 — AI Freelance Marketplace
phases.description: Freelance hiring platform with AI-native job postings. Pioneered 'AI-only opportunities' — lower budget, shorter timespans, where AI does the work. Applicants submitted partial work as their application rather than a traditional proposal — a novel mechanic built in early 2024 before this became mainstream.

phases.name: Phase 3 — Inventory + Quick Commerce Logistics
phases.description: Inventory management software deployed to 30–40 companies managing quick commerce logistics. Included a logistics optimization engine targeting carbon credit minimization — discontinued due to market fit challenges in India.

phases.name: Phase 4 — DeLogi (Supply Chain QR Tracking)
phases.description: QR code-based product provenance system for imported goods. Each product carried a QR code scanned at every supply chain touchpoint to ensure quality and authenticity. Discontinued — market wasn't ready in India.

phases.name: Phase 5 — CatalystIQ Hub (AI Recruitment)
phases.description: Hiring platform with an AI resume screener that 10+ B2B clients used directly to screen 4,000+ candidates, at 99%+ uptime. Reduced client hiring cycle time by 65%. 18% conversion rate. React, TypeScript, Python (Flask), PostgreSQL.

phases.name: Phase 6 — Lead Generation Automations
phases.description: Built custom n8n automation workflows for client lead generation pipelines.

name: Petner
description: Pet-focused social platform. First startup. Multiple iterations over ~11 months.
